requires.description: Collected materials (papers, web, github, datasets) in markdown format

produces.description: Research question definition with scope and context
Primary evidence mapping with gaps and confidence levels
Synthesized judgment from evidence with main conclusion and confidence
Research approach with priorities and timeline

checks: New material or tighter question available for next cycle
Confidence or coverage improved since last iteration
Ready to exit loop into Gate A / next stage
gates.description: Loop checkpoint: iterate deeper or advance to Gate A. Active only when Loop pattern is active or .omr/loop-state.json has active: true
Internal checkpoint: verify evidence is sufficient before plan generation
